title: "Understanding scientific pretraining ladders"

A scaling ladder uses smaller training experiments to support a larger pretraining decision. This site explains Jiaxuan Zou’s literature synthesis, develops the supplied technical notes, and connects practical rules to primary evidence.

## Replicate Marin, then test cyber data

Start with the [PR/code/data/result lineage](data/marin-artifact-lineage.qmd), [stage-specific Marin evaluation](evaluation/marin-evaluation.qmd), and [long-context, SFT and RL experiment account](training/marin-midtraining-posttraining.qmd). These link particular PR heads, HF revisions and result records, and distinguish public inputs from unresolved cloud dependencies.

The [Datakit code walkthrough](data/marin-code-walkthrough.qmd) and [optimizer-search manual](optimizers/marin-hyperparameter-search.qmd) explain the exact contracts and search procedures in pinned code. Compare [Qwen3, OLMoE and Marin MoE architectures](architecture/moe-families.qmd), then read the focused [Step Law](papers/step-law.qmd), [Farseer](papers/farseer.qmd) and [Power Lines](papers/power-lines.qmd) deep dives. The [cyber-data extension](data/cyber-data.qmd) builds on a reproduced broad baseline.

## Start with the blog and notes

Read the [Jiaxuan blog reading guide](reading/jiaxuan-reading-guide.qmd) for the full section crosswalk and suggested reading order. Open the [saved original blog](reading/scientific-scaling-ladder.md) alongside the [annotated Quarto notes](reading/deep-dive-notes.qmd). The notes link their sections and subsections to detailed companions; the [source review](reading/notes-review.qmd) records checked claims and qualifications.

## Current industry workflow and 96-H100 plan

Start with the [industry-practice audit](workflow/industry-practice-audit.qmd), which checks the Jiaxuan conversation against Step Law, Farseer, Power Lines and Marin's code/records. Then read the [data-engineering guide](data/marin-data-engineering.qmd), [trainer playbook](training/trainer-playbook.qmd), [checkpoint-evaluation protocol](evaluation/checkpoint-evaluation.qmd), and [96-GPU × 30-day plan](plans/plan-96-h100.qmd). The plan separates unique tokens from repeated exposures and includes a bounded, priced experiment queue.

The earlier [128-H100 / 40-day proposal](plans/hero-h100-candidate.qmd) remains a historical alternative. Its numerical model and R&D budget are not the current allocation. The [SMELT review](architecture/smelt-looped-moe.qmd) remains the architecture evidence companion.

## Start with an available corpus

The [beginning-to-end pretraining design](workflow/from-data-to-pretraining.qmd) explains how to start from a Nemotron-CC snapshot or a Marin data pipeline and progress through pilots, mixture search, a scaling ladder, validation and the final training run. The [OLMo](efforts/olmo-pretraining.qmd) and [Marin](efforts/marin-pretraining.qmd) deep dives explain how those teams approach each part.

## Follow a question

| Question | Explanation |
|---|---|
| What workflow should I follow? | [Complete experiment workflow](workflow/workflow.qmd) |
| How does a loss law choose model size and tokens? | [Allocation mathematics](deep-dives/loss-and-allocation.qmd) |
| What exactly am I counting? | [Parameters, FLOPs, tokens and loss](deep-dives/measurement-and-compute.qmd) |
| How should I design and fit the experiments? | [Grid geometry and statistical inference](deep-dives/grid-and-inference.qmd) |
| How do width, depth and μP work in actual ladders? | [Architecture evidence and decision flowchart](architecture/architecture-evidence.qmd) |
| How do batch, LR, decay and schedules interact? | [Schedules and optimizer timescales](deep-dives/schedules-and-timescales.qmd) |
| How do I choose mixtures and control repetition? | [Data exposure and repetition](deep-dives/data-and-repetition.qmd) |
| How do I predict and validate capabilities? | [Task prediction and validation gates](deep-dives/capabilities-and-validation.qmd) |
| What does a production recipe look like? | [Nemotron pretraining case study](efforts/nemotron-pretraining.qmd) |

The section protocols in the sidebar explain all 12 blog sections and its public ladder examples. The guides describe published practices and proposed experiment designs; this repository has not run the training experiments.
